fact: Guinéenne de Fibre Optique states it decided to invest USD 50 million over five years to build networks in all 33 prefectures, with 1,200 km of fibre deployed in Conakry by May 2024 and 1,500 km planned for 2024.
title: Quel est le montant de la réalisation des infrastructures métropolitaines de fibre optique ?
